name: Bambu Usage Tracking
description: Deducts the filament of Bambu Lab prints from the matching FilaMan spools, using the AMS slots of the Bambu Lab driver, with a print history and plate previews. Requires FilaMan 2.0.6 or newer; restart FilaMan once after the first install. Do not combine with Bambuddy's usage tracking on the same printer, or every print is deducted twice.
author: Niko11111
